engine_limitations.raptor_and_krug: TFM2 has no fifth or sixth ordinary neutral actor/spawn state; these two generated packs are not claimed as independently spawning camps.
engine_limitations.elemental_dragon_state_machine: API 0.8 now deterministically selects one of five base elemental dragons per match from the authoritative match seed; both teams and replay derive the same visual. The public API still exposes no safe per-respawn rotation, Dragon Soul, or Elder-transition hook, and a replay opened before any MatchUIRunner database handle safely retains default serpen.
engine_limitations.first_blood_announcer: The official First Blood event, container, media ID, WEM and decoded hash are audited. TFM2 exposes native sound dispatch only for 2/3/4/5 multikills, while IngameUIRunner kill logs and play_sound remain private and Mod API 0.8 has no safe global first-kill sound callback. No OS-level bypass or guessed every-kill remap is shipped.
